vision.name: Hercule
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Named cards cannot have their damage modified by your effects. Your opponent's attacks deal -3 stages and -3 life cards of damage. You cannot use the effects of [Continuous] Drills.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Search your Life Deck for "Hercule's Dynamite Kick" and place it into your hand.
DAMAGE: 2 stages.
vision.note: PZP MP (FanZ Personality layout); right edge reads 'HERO' (no ALLY). Power stages are printed ASCENDING (5 ... 50) above 0; printed design, not a misread
